faq: Common ones include StoreKit purchases, Firebase, Stripe for physical goods, Mixpanel, Klaviyo, OneSignal and any REST API. If a provider has a Swift SDK or a clear API, we can usually connect it.
Can I take card payments for digital content with Stripe?

Apple requires its own in-app purchase for digital content such as subscriptions and premium features. Stripe or Apple Pay suit physical goods and services. We follow the App Review Guidelines and tell you which route fits.

What if my backend has no documentation?
Send what you have and we inspect the calls ourselves. If the interface is unclear, we write down what we found and confirm it with you. Large backend changes are outside this service.
